outputs.discrepancies: The caption for panel G only describes immunoblotting/zymography of normal mucosa (N) and polyps (P) from ApcMin/+ and Asef-/-ApcMin/+ mice, plus a bar graph of relative expression (Asef, pJNK1, MMP9). However, the panel image also includes an additional blot/zymogram set (right-hand sub-panel) comparing normal mucosa and polyps of increasing diameter (2, 3, 4, 5 mm) for Asef, pJNK1, JNK1, MMP9 (zymo) and Actin. This polyp-size-series data and the quantification bar graph with significance asterisks are not mentioned or explained anywhere in the caption text.
